## Tiger Global Q2 13F: Trims Broad Big Tech, Adds AMD and SpaceX

A high-profile fund rotating from broad big tech into AMD and SpaceX is an institutional endorsement of two specific sub-themes within tech; useful positioning context but should be weighted against the inherent 13F lag before treating as a current signal.

- Tiger Global's Q2 13F shows reduced exposure to large-cap technology names.
- New or increased positions include AMD and SpaceX, per coverage of the filing.
- The rotation signals institutional preference shifting toward AI chip competition (AMD) and the space economy (SpaceX).
- Standard 13F caveat applies: end-of-quarter holdings carry a lag and may not reflect current positioning.
